answer: Farming becomes a pulse bet on surviving 96 epochs of grading, and every pigment settlement recomputes the ledge schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 96 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
